lann:webcrypto

A WIT interface for web-platform-compatible cryptography, with a Wasmtime host, a browser (jco) host, and an in-guest provider — source repository.

  • WPT parity runner — the web-platform-tests WebCryptoAPI suites run live in your browser, against its own crypto.subtle and through the component round trip
  • lann-webcrypto-wasmtime — API docs for the Wasmtime host crate
  • lann-webcrypto-guest — API docs for the guest-side SDK
